footer: Compiled from Reuters, CNN, TechCrunch, Times of India and Al Jazeera reports filed on 18 November 2026 (morning, WIB).
sources_note: All seven stories were reported on 18 November 2026; the Iran-Bahrain exchange and Nvidia earnings were verified across multiple outlets.

stories.headline: Iran drones hit US radar in Bahrain; US strikes back
stories.summary: Iran's Guards sent drones at a US radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base; Bahrain and the US say they were intercepted. US jets then hit a missile site on Qeshm Island.

stories.headline: Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge for second day
stories.source: Times of India / Jagran Josh, 18 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Kyiv struck the bridge linking Russia to Crimea for a second straight day, while Russian forces pounded bridges in the Ukrainian capital.

stories.headline: Trump in Manila for Quad talks, then to China
stories.summary: President Trump arrived in the Philippines for Quad talks ahead of a China visit, as leaders gather for the APEC summit in Shenzhen on 18-19 November.

stories.headline: Canada, China extend trade deals at APEC
stories.summary: Ottawa and Beijing extended trade cooperation as President Xi met Prime Minister Carney on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

stories.headline: Nvidia revenue doubles to $115.8bn post-Huang
stories.summary: The chipmaker beat forecasts with revenue up 103% year on year and guided to $130bn next quarter, but its board said ousted CEO Jensen Huang will not return.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan strengthens over Bay of Bengal
stories.source: India Meteorological Dept via Times of India, 18 Nov 2026
stories.summary: The storm is likely to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm, disrupting flights including the Chennai-Yangon service as warnings go out around the bay.

stories.headline: Gaza ceasefire 'faces imminent collapse'
stories.summary: The Board of Peace warned the Gaza ceasefire could collapse without urgent action, as aid agencies report displaced families getting one hot meal every two days.

subtitle: Seven stories that defined Wednesday, 18 November 2026
title: THE WORLD TODAY
